name: Warranty Policy.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Saga Telecom warrants that the supplied models will be free of defects in materials, workmanship, and of standard functions indicated in the product brochure.
Warranty period is 1 year for commercial models(STC series) and 3 years for industrial models(STI series), for the product category that is not listed as below still follows the rule.
Product Category	Product Line	Warranty
Commercial Ethernet	Commercial Network Switch	1 Year
Commercial Ethernet	Commercial POE Switch	1 Year
Commercial Ethernet	Commercial Managed Switch	1 Year
Commercial Ethernet	Commercial POE Managed Switch	1 Year
POE Accessory	POE Injector	1 Year
POE Accessory	POE Adapter	1 Year
POE Accessory	POE Splitter	1 Year
POE Accessory	POE Extender	1 Year
Ethernet Media Converter	100M/1G/10G	1 Year
Industrial Networking	Industrial Ethernet Switch	3 Years
Industrial Networking	Industrial Fiber Switch	3 Years
Industrial Networking	Industrial POE Switch	3 Years
Industrial Networking	Industrial Managed Switch	3 Years
Industrial Networking	Industrial POE Managed Switch	3 Years
Din Power Adapter	20W/75W/120W/240W/480W Series	3 Years
Warranty comes in effect from the date of delivery.
Purchased items are seen as standard or non-defective without negative feedback within 2 months from the date of delivery.
Warranty is non-transferable and will be solely provided to the original buyer as per the invoice information.
Immediate contact is strongly advised once any problem occurs, Saga Telecom should be well informed all along before standard solution is provided.
Please properly keep purchase-related information(purchase order, proforma invoice, packing list etc.) for any possible repair, replacement or after-sales issues.
Please do not remove or ruin the product label(there is serial number) on the device.
Please do not repair or replace components of purchased items without our knowing or authorization.
Unauthorized returns are not accepted without a valid confirmation from Saga Telecom, any risk or expenses involved are not covered in such cases.
At Saga Telecom’s option, the disputed device will be preferably repaired or replaced.
Defective products within warranty but unable to be repaired or discontinued, 10%~20% discount will be offered when the customer purchases the alternative models with identical service features.
If there are expenses during the repair, Saga Telecom will negotiate with the customer on how to split the cost, and generally give discounts in new orders to cover this cost.
Saga Telecom reserves final adjudication rights and sole discretion during the warranty period.
Exclusive Liability
Out of warranty period
Order of wrong models
Huge defects due to improper use including but not limited to circuit burnout, PCB board deformation, water-soaked chip
Hardware and software compatibility failure
Consumable materials and routine maintenance such as a fuse or bracket
Unauthorized modification to important components
Our service belief is quality, honesty and professionalism, those valuable assets have been leading Saga Telecom to deliver standard after-sales solutions.
Please let us know if you have any after-sales query.
